implementation_decisions: The representative artifact matrix covers nine CPU/storage/strategy/batch/tag configurations, with further delayed-completion and producer-reassignment cases. It is not a full Cartesian matrix or a performance measurement.

Strict-memory terminal transport returns admitted rank-ordered complete frames. Worker-local native offsets/permutations are not transported; the coordinator reconstructs checked little-endian offsets and validates exact identity coverage before publication.

One next coordinator refinement may overlap earlier pending terminals, with both parent and authenticated child frontier retained until canonical drain. Ordinary worker sort runs/merge groups are bounded to512KiB; larger records/groups use the admitted coordinator fallback.

Source normalized digests are computed by the worker PairedReader during original-order ingress; coordinator scatter validation checks source identity coverage, routing, counts, lengths and authenticated result bytes. Complete verification independently reconstructs per-source hashes.
Direct inventory drain performs64 bounded metadata scans rather than retaining an unbounded locator list. Its I/O tradeoff requires Plan16 measurement.
limitations: All executed qualification here is local Linux x86-64 CPython3.11.7. macOS arm64 and CPython3.14 were not executed; configured CI is not passing platform evidence.

Worker/helper/codec/sort/metadata/transport coefficients remain versioned admission policy, not calibrated native-build or universal hard RSS guarantees. Greater-than-four-times-admitted-RAM and representative performance workloads remain outstanding.

Plan15 retains wider real-workflow boundary, ENOSPC, short-write, pressure, publication, late-recovery and SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGKILL residue matrices. The local production failure tests do not close all combinations.

The full supplied30042389-pair mix/fullverify/both-recovery workload remains unexecuted. This candidate runs only a bounded128-pair-per-sample prefix, full-prefix-pool verification and both prefix recoveries.
Local development packaging reuses installed dependencies and direct backend builds. This is not an isolated locked immutable Plan17 release candidate.
Uncatchable termination can leave protected scratch/private staging residue; no automatic resume is supported. Foreign or uncertain ownership prevents guessed deletion and retains cleanup authority.

The interpreter-owned resource-tracker helper may persist after invocation cleanup; ReadMixer observes/reserves it while active and reaps its own task workers. The launch lock cannot isolate unrelated application environment mutation.
